title: Grateful Dead Live at Family Dog at the Great Highway on 1970-02-27
venue: Family Dog at the Great Highway

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture of a stellar early‑1970 set highlighted by the NFA → Lovelight sequence and an electrifying Easy Wind.
ai_review.review: The February 27, 1970 Family Dog show shines with Jerry’s peak guitar work, Pigpen’s wild organ/vocals and memorable moments like NFA → Lovelight, Easy Wind and a uniquely quirky Cold Rain and Snow intro. Charlie Miller’s transfer delivers a crisp, well‑balanced mix despite the tape run‑out at the very end, making it a must‑have for collectors.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise both performance and recording; weighted average (70 % show quality ≈4.1, 30 % recording quality ≈3.4) yields ~3.9 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp mix praised by several reviewers; Charlie Miller’s transfer highlighted as excellent. Minor issues noted: tape runs out a few seconds at the end and early‑show monitor problems mentioned by one reviewer.

standout_songs: The Other One > Lovelight (NFA → Lovelight transition)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong early momentum with smooth transitions, especially the celebrated NFA→Lovelight sequence; the set maintains high energy throughout and closes on a triumphant Lovelight.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for playing his finest guitar work of the era, delivering crisp tone and inventive solos.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir’s vocal delivery on Me and My Uncle noted as melodic; his backing vocals with Pigpen highlighted during Lovelight.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ/vocals described as peak, adding wild energy and unique rap sections.
band_member_comments.Drums: One reviewer called the separate ‘Drums’ track absurd, but no further comments on drumming performance.
